Content: Chat streaming flows from IChatProvider.StreamAsync through MemoryChatAgent.StreamAsync into Chat.razor. Providers emit ChatProviderChunk content and thinking deltas; MemoryChatAgent accumulates them, builds final MemoryChatResponse context/write metadata, and emits a final MemoryChatStreamUpdate. Chat.razor mutates the pending assistant turn in place, tracks streamed character count and elapsed time, saves in-flight turns periodically, and clears the progress state before final persistence so the loading bar does not linger. The Stop button next to Send cancels the active CancellationTokenSource passed into StreamAsync; stopped generations keep any partial assistant text, stamp the provider/model metadata, and show Generation stopped instead of surfacing cancellation as a request failure. Thinking deltas set ChatTurnState.ThinkingActive, render as a details block above the visible response, open while active, and use app.css animation classes for a live activity dot and caret. Ollama thinking can come from a message.thinking field or from split <think> tags; GitHub reasoning maps from SDK reasoning events.
Title: Chat Streaming and Thinking Blocks
